To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) incremental circuit analysis can be performed efficiently by using a hash table to retain information between executions and (2) a hierarchy can be extracted from a flat netlist by coloring the vertices of the network and comparing the colorings using a standard hash table algorithm.

1) the extracted hierarchy is a very useful tool in switch-level simulation, 2) a hash-table approach is an effective method to implement incremental circuit analysis in a simulator that supports extracted hierarchy, and 3) our implementation of this technique has been very successful.

(1) the use of subnetwork hierarchy is an important technique for reducing the preprocessing time of incremental circuit analysis, (2) a simple and effective algorithm can be used to extract a subnetwork hierarchy from a flat network, and (3) the use of the file system as the hash table for the subnetwork hierarchy is effective.
